expectations.text: 输出包含完整的模块化蓝图文件集
expectations.evidence: 输出含 PRD、SPEC、3 个领域 specs、DESIGN、ARCHITECTURE、SECURITY、DEPLOY、ENGINEERING、CLAUDE 与 AGENTS，共 12 份蓝图文档。

expectations.text: PRD 与 SPEC 使用稳定 ID 并建立追踪
expectations.evidence: PRD 使用 PRD-SCHED/BOOK/COACH/ACCESS IDs；SPEC.md 逐项映射到 SPEC IDs、设计、架构和测试状态。

expectations.text: 领域规格包含 Given/When/Then 和验收方法
expectations.evidence: scheduling.md、booking.md、coach-workspace.md 均包含 GIVEN/WHEN/THEN 场景和 Acceptance method。

expectations.text: 未知项被登记并阻断相应就绪度
expectations.evidence: TBD-* 记录 owner、decision-by 与 blocked gate；SPEC.md 的三个 readiness gate 均为 blocked。

expectations.text: 未无依据采用复杂架构或中间件
expectations.evidence: ARCHITECTURE.md 采用 provisional 模块化单体与关系库，明确无证据时不引入 Redis、队列、搜索、微服务或 Kubernetes。

notes: All three readiness gates remain blocked pending product decisions.

expectations.text: PRD 完整记录用户、范围、团队、规模和预算
expectations.evidence: PRD.md records iOS/Android/responsive Web, Flutter/TypeScript team, six-month MVP, 20k DAU and ¥8,000 monthly infrastructure budget.

expectations.text: SPEC 覆盖关键成功及失败行为
expectations.evidence: Eight domain specs cover OTP, plans, check-in, media upload, reminders, coach authorization, platform and privacy with success and failure scenarios.

expectations.text: DESIGN 覆盖移动端状态与无障碍
expectations.evidence: DESIGN.md includes responsive/mobile permissions, loading/empty/error/offline states, accessibility and platform behavior.

expectations.text: 架构推荐与小团队和预算约束一致
expectations.evidence: ARCHITECTURE.md recommends a TypeScript modular monolith and managed relational/object services, with tradeoffs and measurable revisit triggers.

expectations.text: 安全部署覆盖中国大陆与移动发布约束
expectations.evidence: SECURITY/DEPLOY cover personal data and photos, SMS/push providers, mainland hosting/filing questions, app stores, backup, rollback and observability.

expectations.text: SPEC 覆盖租户、权限、上传和支付异常
expectations.evidence: Domain specs cover tenant SSO/isolation, approval authorization, invoice upload rejection/failure, payment failure, unknown result and duplicate webhook behavior.

expectations.text: 安全文档覆盖敏感数据、多租户、SSO 和支付
expectations.evidence: SECURITY.md inventories identity, invoice and bank data and maps tenant, SSO, file and payment threats to controls and verification.

expectations.text: 合规事项标记官方核源与负责人而非认证结论
expectations.evidence: Regional/legal items use stable TBDs with legal/security owners and explicitly state that the blueprint is not a legal conclusion or certification.

expectations.text: 区域数据边界与 RPO/RTO 有验证方案
expectations.evidence: ARCHITECTURE, DEPLOY and ADR 0001 keep EU data/backup/telemetry/recovery in EU and require measured recovery evidence for RPO 15m/RTO 2h.

expectations.text: 未决高风险事项阻断生产就绪度
expectations.evidence: SPEC.md readiness ledger keeps production-ready blocked by legal, security, payment, region and recovery TBDs.

notes: Legal, payment and security owners must resolve the recorded production blockers.

expectations.text: PRD/SPEC 固化人工确认与人工降级
expectations.evidence: PRD-APPROVAL/DEGRADE and SPEC-AI-002/003 make AI draft-only, require explicit agent confirmation, and preserve manual chat when AI fails.

expectations.text: SPEC 覆盖流式、检索、越权和重复发送异常
expectations.evidence: chat.md, ai-assist.md and knowledge.md contain scenarios for stream interruption, missing/withdrawn knowledge, cross-tenant denial and idempotent duplicate send.

expectations.text: 架构分别论证中间件并给出移除条件
expectations.evidence: ARCHITECTURE.md separately evaluates realtime, Redis/cache, queue and model provider; it defers Redis/broker and gives measurable introduce/revisit/exit conditions.

expectations.text: 安全文档覆盖 AI 数据和提示注入风险
expectations.evidence: SECURITY.md requires no provider training, retrieval ACLs, prompt-injection isolation, no model tool permissions and provider/DPA review.

expectations.text: 部署门禁监控性能、并发、质量、成本和降级

notes: Region, DPA, availability SLO and recovery objectives remain production blockers.

expectations.evidence: A dedicated table states when cache, queue, realtime and model providers are needed or should not be used, with staged recommendations.

expectations.text: 部署门禁监控性能、并发、质量、成本和降级
expectations.evidence: Launch criteria and delivery phases cover first-token latency, 3000/6000 connections, AI quality, ¥50k cost and model failure/manual degradation.

notes: Detailed latency and monthly budget allocations are proposed without provider measurements.
With-skill outputs passed all 20 expectations; baseline outputs passed 14 of 20.
The largest discriminating gain is in vague projects: stable PRD/SPEC IDs, traceability, registered TBDs, and explicit design/implementation/production readiness gates.

The fully specified mobile eval passed in both configurations, showing that content-focused assertions alone do not distinguish the skill; future iterations should add cross-document consistency and non-fabrication checks.

Strong baselines also handled cross-region and AI architecture well. The skill's added value there is durable behavior scenarios, authority boundaries, and explicit production blockers rather than raw technical coverage.
With-skill artifacts average 65,869 output characters versus 29,582 without skill. This is a substantial review burden; a compact output mode is a priority for a future iteration.
Timing/token telemetry was unavailable from the isolated runs; benchmark token values are output-character proxies from grading metrics, not model token counts.
